## Context
The grounding worker harness hard-codes POSIX `fork`. CPython 3.12 warns when this runs in a multithreaded host because the child can deadlock; Python 3.14 no longer defaults to fork. Runtime experiments confirmed `multiprocessing/popen_fork.py -> os.fork()` is the warning source, while spawn preserves 46/47 existing lifecycle tests. The one failure is a test fixture that attaches an unpicklable local closure to a Process. No production caller exists in-repo, but `run_in_worker` is publicly re-exported.

## Approved API contract
- Default to the cross-platform `spawn` context.
- Accept an optional caller-supplied multiprocessing context for informed legacy/frozen-executable compatibility; callers explicitly selecting fork own its thread-safety risk.
- Require worker callables to be importable module-level names and args, kwargs, and return values to be pickleable. Future C-extension bindings construct parser/query state inside the child from plain-data arguments.
- Preserve the documented never-raise/fail-open contract: process start and pickling failures, plus parent receive/unpickling failures, return an abstaining `RunResult`.
- Do not add cloudpickle/loky without a demonstrated production caller requiring dynamic callables.

## Plan
- Add held-out behavioral coverage proving the default worker completes under a live background thread with the fork warning promoted to error.
- Add contract coverage for explicit context injection and non-pickleable start/receive failures mapping to fail-open results.
- Switch the default context to spawn, expose optional context injection, and make start/receive cleanup exception-safe.
- Replace the spawn-incompatible reap-lag test mutation with a parent-only proxy while preserving the crash-vs-timeout oracle.
- Document the public callable/serialization contract and explicit fork escape hatch.
- Run the grounding lifecycle/conformance matrix, mutation checks, lint, typecheck, and repository gates.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Default `run_in_worker` completes under a live background thread with the fork deadlock warning treated as an error.
- [x] An explicitly supplied multiprocessing context is used.
- [x] Non-importable or non-pickleable worker inputs return `RunResult(abstain_reason="other")` without raising.
- [x] Parent receive/unpickling failures return `RunResult(abstain_reason="other")` without raising.
- [x] Timeout, large-result drain, exception, signal-crash, cleanup, and reap-lag contracts remain green under spawn.
- [x] The documented public contract states importability/pickleability requirements and the explicit fork risk.
- [x] Focused grounding tests, lint, typecheck, and repository tests pass.
